title: Assembly Performance Metrics and Test Methods
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: Task-board competencies, task conditions, repeated trials, and meaningful assembly performance measurement.
limitation: Research and benchmark description; not evidence of universal robotic assembly capability.

title: Systems Engineering Handbook: 2.0 Fundamentals of Systems Engineering
organization: NASA
supports: Distinction between product verification and validation and the role of integrated system design.
limitation: General guidance, not a qualification of the fictional MERIDIAN design.

title: Robbins & Lawrence Machine Shop, Mechanical Engineering Landmark 120
organization: American Society of Mechanical Engineers
supports: Historical connection between refined machine tools, close dimensional control, and interchangeable manufacture.
limitation: Institutional historical account; book avoids claiming one inventor or site alone created interchangeability.

title: Powering a Generation of Change
organization: Smithsonian National Museum of American History
supports: Centralized generation, transmission and distribution as an interconnected infrastructure; historical changes in organization.
limitation: Primary page text was available through search extraction; two direct opens timed out. No detailed quantitative claim used.

title: MIT Science Reporter: Automatically Programmed Tools
organization: Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Infinite MIT archive
supports: Contemporaneous explanation of numerical control and APT, including the 1952 feasibility demonstration.
limitation: Historical broadcast transcript; not a complete institutional history of every contributor.

title: Automate Honors 50 Years of Robotics
organization: Robotic Industries Association / Association for Advancing Automation
supports: Unimate installation at General Motors in 1961 and hot, heavy die-casting work.
limitation: Industry association retrospective; used only for the dated historical example.

title: Advanced Automation for Space Missions: Technical Summary, NASA-CR-163827
organization: NASA Technical Reports Server
supports: Historical study of machine intelligence, teleoperation, manufacturing and replicating systems; supplied-parts assembler demonstration distinguished from broader lunar factory proposals.
limitation: Technical-summary PDF and relevant self-replication pages inspected. Proposals and conclusions are historical analyses, not operational demonstrations; no growth or economic numbers adopted.

title: Fastener Design Manual, NASA Reference Publication 1228
organization: NASA; Richard T. Barrett
supports: Preload, friction, coatings, lubrication, thermal effects, and the complexity of torque-to-clamping relationships.
limitation: Historical manual, primarily aeronautical; not an installation procedure or current certification basis for any reader-built hardware.

title: Keeping Space Mechanisms Lubricated
organization: European Space Agency
supports: Lubricant loss and contamination concerns in vacuum; research on labyrinth-seal geometry.
limitation: Research-program report; does not establish universal long-life performance for every mechanism.

title: Metrological Traceability: Frequently Asked Questions and NIST Policy
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
date: n.d.; live policy and FAQ page
supports: Traceability as a property of a measurement result and the documented calibration chain with uncertainty contributions.
limitation: Educational paraphrase; no claim that fictional measurements are actually traceable.

title: The Gage Block Handbook, NIST Monograph 180
organization: NIST; Theodore D. Doiron and John S. Beers
supports: Role of gauge blocks, calibration, comparison, and statistical measurement assurance.
limitation: Publication record and abstract used; no detailed calibration procedure reproduced.

title: Guidelines for Evaluating and Expressing the Uncertainty of NIST Measurement Results, Technical Note 1297
organization: NIST; Barry N. Taylor and Chris E. Kuyatt
supports: Standard and expanded uncertainty and the role of an uncertainty model.
limitation: The 0.004/0.003 millimeter example is original and illustrative; coverage is not asserted to be an exact probability.

title: How Microchips Are Made
organization: ASML
supports: Layered wafer fabrication and controlled cleanroom production.
limitation: Manufacturer overview; no universal process count, purity, cleanroom-class, or manufacturing-time number adopted.

title: Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026
organization: U.S. Geological Survey, National Minerals Information Center
supports: Official recurring resource for commodity-specific production, trade and industry information.
limitation: No commodity statistics or shortage numbers extracted; used as a research route, not proof of a particular supply forecast.

title: Primary Production 101
organization: The Aluminum Association
supports: Bauxite-to-alumina-to-aluminum production sequence, Bayer and Hall-Heroult process distinction.
limitation: Industry overview; no current cost, emissions, or energy-intensity claim adopted.

title: Additive Manufacturing Part Qualification
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: AM qualification challenges involving surfaces, defects, residual stress, anisotropy and post-processing.
limitation: Research objectives and measurement challenges; no universal qualification duration or cost claimed.

title: NASA-STD-6030: Additive Manufacturing Requirements for Spaceflight Systems
organization: NASA Technical Standards System
supports: Existence and scope of NASA requirements addressing additive design, fabrication and testing for flight hardware.
limitation: Record and scope consulted, not a complete compliance review or certification instruction.

title: Grasping Performance Metrics and Test Methods
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: Task and function-level measurement of grasping, including the need for independent measurement.
limitation: Benchmark framework; no product ranking or universal gripper capability inferred.

title: Calibration and Registration Tools
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: Robot accuracy versus repeatability, task-space calibration, and changes caused by wear or environment.
limitation: General program explanation; no numerical accuracy assumed for MERIDIAN.

title: Tolerances and Uncertainty in Robotic Systems
organization: NIST; Frederick M. Proctor, John L. Michaloski and Marek Franaszek
supports: Complementary roles of calibration, compliance and sensing in robot applications.
limitation: Abstract consulted; no detailed experimental result or accuracy figure adopted.

title: Modern Robotics, 3.3.1: Homogeneous Transformation Matrices
organization: Northwestern University; Kevin M. Lynch and Frank C. Park
supports: Reference frames, position/orientation transformations, and order dependence.
limitation: Book's two-dimensional numerical example is original and illustrative, not a reproduced exercise.

title: Common Cause Failures Dominate and Defeat Redundancy
organization: NASA Ames Research Center; Harry W. Jones
supports: Common-cause dependence can defeat redundant systems; shared resources and designs matter.
limitation: No empirical common-cause fraction adopted. All chapter probabilities are explicitly invented for teaching.

title: Operations and Maintenance: Reliability-Centered Maintenance Guide overview
organization: NASA Office of Strategic Infrastructure
supports: Maintenance strategies organized around mission performance, reliability and lifecycle consequences.
limitation: Overview rather than a task-specific maintenance instruction; reader work requires equipment-specific procedures.

title: Systems Engineering Handbook: Appendix C, How to Write a Good Requirement; Appendix D, Requirements Verification Matrix
organization: NASA
supports: Requirements tied to verification methods and explicit records.
limitation: General guidance; fictional requirements and gate system are this book's educational design.

title: How Silicon Die Become Chip Packages
organization: Intel
supports: Semiconductor assembly, packaging and test as additional manufacturing stages beyond wafer fabrication.
limitation: Manufacturer educational description; no comparative performance or economic claim adopted.

title: Towards Measurement of Advanced Mobile Manipulator Performance for Assembly Applications, NIST TN 2108
organization: NIST; Roger V. Bostelman and colleagues
supports: Need to measure coordinated mobile-base and manipulator performance for assembly.
limitation: No reported fiducial-detection size generalized into a product capability; methods used only as a bounded research example.

title: Outgassing Database User Guide
organization: NASA Goddard Engineering and Technology Directorate
supports: Controlled vacuum testing of material mass loss and collected condensable material for spacecraft selection.
limitation: No material deemed flight-qualified; database conditions and actual formulation remain relevant.

title: Six Crucial Steps in Semiconductor Manufacturing
organization: ASML; Alison Li and Jessica Timings
supports: Conceptual sequence including deposition, lithography, etching, ion implantation and packaging.
limitation: Overview contains simplifications; no purity, exact process count or universal device recipe reproduced.
